user.title: Home Organizer Setup
user.description: Choose how Home Organizer should process AI requests.

data_description.processing_mode: Hybrid uses your local AI for text and a cloud model for images.
data_description.ai_provider: Only used in Cloud or Hybrid mode. Gemini has a generous free tier.
data_description.use_stylist: Requires additional setup on the next screen.

api_keys.title: API Keys and Models
api_keys.description: Credentials are stored in your Home Assistant configuration and are never written to the log.

data_description.custom_cloud_url: Optional. Typically only used for enterprise proxies.
data_description.local_api_url: Ollama: http://YOUR_IP:11434/v1. LM Studio: http://YOUR_IP:1234/v1. Must end in /v1.
data_description.local_api_key: Local servers usually ignore this, but do not leave it blank. Type 'ollama' or 'local'.
data_description.local_model: Used for ordinary questions and chat. Run 'ollama list' and copy the name exactly, for example llama3:8b. This model does not need to support images.
data_description.local_model_vision: Used for receipt and barcode photos, and for future features that look at your wardrobe. Must be a multimodal model - for example llama3.2-vision, qwen2-vl, minicpm-v or llava. Leave blank to reuse the text model above, which only works if that model also supports images.

stylist.title: Virtual Try-On
stylist.description: Configure the image generation provider used by the Stylist agent.

data_description.vto_model: Only needed if you use a custom workflow.

triggers.title: Trigger Words and Permissions
triggers.description: Trigger words are translated into your interface language automatically. You can override any of them here in any language.

data.allow_scripts: Allow the assistant to run scripts and scenes
data.delete_on_remove: Delete all data when the integration is removed

data_description.allow_scripts: Off by default. A script can perform any action you wrote into it, including operating a lock, so enable this only if you want the assistant to start your scripts. Locks, covers and alarm panels are never controlled by the assistant directly; those requests are handled by Home Assistant's own voice assistant.
data_description.delete_on_remove: Caution: this permanently wipes the database and all stored images.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance of Home Organizer is supported

add_category.name: Add category
add_category.description: Add a category or sub-category to the list.

add_item.name: Add item
add_item.description: Add an item to a location in the inventory.

ai_action.name: AI action
ai_action.description: Send a request to the AI assistant.

clear_all_data.name: Clear all data
clear_all_data.description: Delete every item, location and setting.

clear_all_items.name: Clear all items
clear_all_items.description: Delete every item, keeping locations and settings.

clipboard_action.name: Clipboard action
clipboard_action.description: Copy or cut the selected items.

confirm_pending.name: Confirm scanned item
confirm_pending.description: Approve a scanned item and add it to the inventory.

delete_item.name: Delete item
delete_item.description: Remove an item from the inventory.

delete_receipt.name: Delete receipt
delete_receipt.description: Permanently delete a receipt, its images and its price history.

delete_scan.name: Discard scan
delete_scan.description: Discard an unreviewed scan with its items and images.

duplicate_item.name: Duplicate item
duplicate_item.description: Create a copy of an item in the same location.

navigate.name: Navigate
navigate.description: Move the panel to a location in the inventory tree.

paste_item.name: Paste item
paste_item.description: Paste a copied or cut item into the current location.

rename_category.name: Rename category
rename_category.description: Rename a category or sub-category and move its items.

set_receipt_currency.name: Set receipt currency
set_receipt_currency.description: Correct the currency recorded on a receipt.

set_view_context.name: Set view context
set_view_context.description: Change which view the panel is showing.

trigger_search.name: Search
trigger_search.description: Run a search across the inventory.

update_image.name: Update image
update_image.description: Set or replace the photo or icon of an item.

update_item_details.name: Update item details
update_item_details.description: Change the name, category or unit of an item.

update_item_extras.name: Update price and dates
update_item_extras.description: Set the purchase price, expiry date or warranty end date of an item.

update_order_qty.name: Update order quantity
update_order_qty.description: Change how many of an item to buy.

update_qty.name: Update quantity
update_qty.description: Change the quantity held of an item.

update_stock.name: Update stock
update_stock.description: Mark an item as in stock or out of stock.
